product_metadata.title: 12 Pack Fairy Lights Battery Operated, 3 Speed Modes, Extra 12 Batteries for Replacement, 7Ft 20 LED Mini String Lights, Waterproof Twinkle Firefly Lights for DIY Christmas Decoration
features: Upgraded Switch Button & 3 Speed Modes: 12 Pack 20 super bright leds fairy lights battery operated are made of high quality 7 feet long bendable wire, which is enough to decor all the items you want. Compared with other mini led lights that only have one light mode, our twinkle lights can easily be turned on/off and switched between three modes with just one button. (3 modes: solid, rapid blinking or slow blinking)

Battery Operated Led Lights: Each fairy light included 2* CR2032 batteries, providing more than 72 hours of battery life, longer working time than other's 24 or 48 hours fairy string lights. Besides, the blinking lights also come with 12 extra CR2032 batteries for replacement.(In order to protect the battery, new lights have an insulator in the battery box. For the first use, you need to open the battery box and remove the insulator.)

IP68 Waterproof Fairy String Lights: Design with IP68 waterproof, our string lights can be immersed into the water to create a wonderful scene. These mini led battery lights can be used indoor and outdoor without any worry of moisture or weather damage or short circuit. Note: Only the string lights is waterproof, the battery case is not waterproof.

DIY Decorative String Lights: Blue fairy string lights help to make a great ambience for every normal things, bendable wire can be easily built into the shapes you want. Led fairy lights are perfect for decorating wedding, party, halloween, Christmas, bedroom, valentine's day, flowers, jars, vases, planting and other crafts. Easily carry and place the led fairy lights anywhere you like.

Safe to Touch : The mini string lights are made of premium LED bulbs. The 4.5V fairy lights are low power and insulates heat, remain safe to the touch. No glare, the soft lights in order to protect your eyes. Ideal for adults and children use.
description: LED String lights composed of Ultra Bright Blue Micro LEDs, giving a light fairy effect.
Simple press the button on the battery box to control 3 modes of the fairy lights (solid, slow blinking or rapid blinking) in different scenes.
The string part is waterproof, can even be immersed in water. (Only the string lights are waterproof, the battery box is not waterproof.)

Bendable wire can be easily built into the shapes you want. Led fairy lights perfect to decorate flowers, wedding, party, valentine's day, jars, vases, wine bottles, planting and other crafts. Wrap these fairy lights on them and they will look beautiful!
High quality wire is flexible, you can bend it to any shape or wrapped it on anything you want like wreaths, trees.
LED Color: Blue LED Quantity: 20 Leds Waterproof: IP68 String Length: 2m/7ft Power Supply: 2* CR2032 Batteries ( included)
